name: Brno University of Technology Smartphone PPG Database (BUT PPG)
description: The BUT Smartphone PPG Database (BUT PPG) is an open-access photoplethysmographic benchmark created by the Department of Biomedical Engineering at Brno University of Technology. It contains 480 smartphone-camera PPG recordings acquired from 50 healthy adult subjects (aged 18 to 72) using contemporary smartphones (Xiaomi Mi9, Apple iPhone, etc.) placed against the fingertip. Recordings include resting and post-exercise states and are accompanied by simultaneous reference single-lead ECG ground truth. Version 2.0 provides manual pulse wave annotations, blood volume peak coordinates, and signal quality indices, serving as a primary benchmark for mobile optical heart rate estimation and mobile health AI.
